title: IngestAck
description: AuditForge's response to POST /v1/events. Partitions the submitted batch into accepted, duplicate, and rejected events. Returned with 200 even when some events are rejected; transport/auth failures use 4xx instead.

received.description: Total number of events in the request.

accepted.description: eventIds newly appended to the audit log.

rejected.description: Events that were not stored, each with a reason (e.g. signature verification failure).
